steps.code:
# Parse the archive file content to get list of songs
archive_lines = archive_file['content'].strip().split('\n')
archive_songs = []
for line in archive_lines:
    line = line.strip()
    if line.startswith('- '):
        song_str = line[2:]
        # Split on " by " to get title and artist
        if ' by ' in song_str:
            title, artist = song_str.rsplit(' by ', 1)
            archive_songs.append({'title': title.strip(), 'artist': artist.strip()})
print(archive_songs)
